_comment: The entire provider stack, isolated. Swapping a layer is an edit here plus a redeploy — nothing else in the repo changes. Keys beginning with _ are stripped at deploy time.

model._comment: Gemini 3.5 Flash: low time-to-first-token, reliable tool calling, cheap. NOT 2.5 Flash — Google retires that family in October 2026. Confirm the exact string against Vapi's dashboard dropdown; their supported-model list moves faster than their docs.

transcriber._comment: Deepgram Flux has end-of-turn detection built into the ASR, which removes a whole stage from the pipeline. eotThreshold is the responsiveness knob (0.5-0.6 aggressive, 0.9-1.0 conservative). eotTimeoutMs is the MAXIMUM wait before forcing a turn end, not a typical wait — Vapi documents 2000-10000ms.

fallbackPlan._comment: Nova-3 covers the risk of Flux being the newer model. Different architecture, so a Flux-specific failure does not take the call down.

voice._comment: ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 — ~75ms time to first audio. NOT eleven_turbo_v2_5 (retired, though Vapi docs samples still show it) and NOT Eleven v3 (better sounding but not real-time, so wrong for a voicebot). voiceId is Rachel, a neutral US female voice; swap it by listening, never from a spec sheet.
